items.evidence: Log steps 2-193 show 48 single-channel transfers of 250 uL, each with its own pick up/drop tip, into distinct wells in columns 1,3,...,11. Elution goes column-to-column (A1->A1, A3->A3, etc.), so each sample is traceable.

Reagent order is wrong. Samples go in first (log 2-193), then isopropanol (195-198), then beads (205-206). The paper and rubric require beads, then isopropanol, then sample. The 5 min delay, magnet engage, 4 min delay and 540 uL removal to waste are correct.

Two 500 uL ethanol washes are added (log 390-425 and 476-511) and removed as 200+200+100 uL to waste (428-473, 514-559) with the magnet engaged. Then delay 240 s and disengage magnetic module (561-562).

Elution buffer is added with the magnet off (563-575) but never mixed. Nothing is aspirated or dispensed in the wells between the 100 uL additions and delay 30 s. Recovery is 100 uL (581-602), not about 80 uL.

Sample is added before isopropanol and beads, which reorders the paper's first step. The code also adds an unrequested 3x bead-reservoir pre-mix and recovers 100 uL instead of 80 uL. The elution step lacks mixing.

judge.summary: The protocol handles samples correctly and does the ethanol washes, magnet steps and drying correctly. It fails because it adds sample before isopropanol and beads, never mixes the elution, recovers 100 uL instead of about 80 uL, and adds a bead-reservoir pre-mix the paper does not describe.
